# MakcikGPT SPA Registration — Three-Registry Sync

## The Problem

When a new MakcikGPT article is deployed, three independent surfaces must all know about it:
1. **Static landing page** (bots/discovery) — from `essays.json`
2. **SPA article pages** (browser-rendered) — from `index.ts` module array
3. **SPA landing card list** (browser-rendered) — from `index.ts` meta array

Missing any one breaks a surface.

## Registry 1: essays.json (SOT)

**File:** `src/data/essays.json`
**Feeds:** Static index, feed.xml, sitemap.xml, llms.txt
**Generated by:** `generate-makcik-index.cjs` (runs during `npm run build` prebuild)

Entry format:
```json
{
  "id": "m1-7",
  "slug": "13-sebab-taufik-kena-berhenti",
  "title": "13 Sebab Tengku Taufik Kena Berhenti Sekarang",
  "date": "2026-08-09",
  "categories": ["PETRONAS", "CEO", "Amanah"],
  "dest": {"type": "onsite", "path": "/world/makcikgpt/13-sebab-taufik-kena-berhenti"},
  "series": {"id": "M1", "n": 7},
  "seal": "999",
  "lang": "bm",
  "tags": ["petronas", "amanah", "ceo", "kontrak", "dividen", "capex"]
}
```

**Required fields:** `id`, `slug`, `title`, `date`, `lang`, `series`, `tags`, `dest`, `seal`

## Registry 2: index.ts module array

**File:** `src/data/makcikgpt/index.ts`
**Feeds:** Vite SPA bundle — article content for browser rendering

```ts
import thirteenSebabTaufikKenaBerhenti from "./13-sebab-taufik-kena-berhenti";

export const makcikArticleModules: ArticleContent[] = [
  // ... existing entries ...
  thirteenSebabTaufikKenaBerhenti,
];
```

## Registry 3: index.ts meta array

```ts
export const makcikArticlesMeta: MakcikArticleMeta[] = [
  {
    slug: '13-sebab-taufik-kena-berhenti',
    title: '13 Sebab Tengku Taufik Kena Berhenti Sekarang',
    subtitle: '...',
    date: '2026-08-09',
    domain: 'MAKCIKGPT × PETRONAS × AMANAH',
    language: 'ms',
    excerpt: '...',
    tags: ['petronas', 'amanah', 'ceo', 'kontrak', 'dividen', 'capex'],
    seal: '999',
    provenance_status: 'sealed',
  },
];
```

## Failure Modes

| Missed Registry | Symptom | Diagnosis |
|-----------------|---------|-----------|
| essays.json | Static index not regenerated; bots see old count | `grep -c "$SLUG" /var/www/html/arif/makcikgpt-md/index.html` = 0 |
| Module array | SPA can't render article; browser shows "ARTICLE NOT FOUND" | `grep -c "$SLUG" dist/assets/index-*.js` = 0 or 1 |
| Meta array | Article count badge wrong; landing page card missing | Bundle has content but count still old |

## Build Pipeline

```
npm run build
  → prebuild: generate-makcik-index.cjs (essays.json → static index)
  → prebuild: generate-makcik-articles.cjs (essays.json + .ts → static HTML)
  → tsc -b → vite build → postbuild
```

**Critical:** Prebuild scripts run FIRST and can overwrite manual changes. Always update `essays.json` and `index.ts` BEFORE running `npm run build`.

## Debugging

```bash
grep "$SLUG" src/data/essays.json
BUNDLE=$(ls -t dist/assets/index-*.js | head -1)
grep -c "$SLUG" "$BUNDLE"
grep -c "$SLUG" public/makcikgpt-md/index.html
curl -s "https://arif-fazil.com/world/makcikgpt/" | grep -oE '"[0-9]+ ARTICLES"'
```
